card.name: Word starts split before odd endings
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that has been split up, such as 'sh' or 'sm' in English or a single Japanese or Greek letter. It fires where the rest of the word is still to come.

modes.label: English sh/sm starts
modes.description: The pieces 'sh' or 'sm' begin a word that is finished in the next piece.

modes.label: Greek word start
modes.description: A single Greek letter begins a word in an etymology note.

card.writes: It promotes pieces from other scripts, such as Malayalam and Thai, and suppresses Indic vowel marks.
card.plain: It marks the start of a word that is cut into pieces, where the model expects the rest of the word to follow.
